# Baseline for cmd/tools/audit_parallel_globals: tests that call
# t.Parallel() and then read or write process-global state.
#
# Unlike the dead-code and JSON budgets, this one is meant to stay EMPTY.
# A parallel test reading runtime.NumGoroutine or runtime.ReadMemStats is
# measuring its neighbours, and one writing os.Setenv or os.Chdir is
# changing them. The fix is available in every case: drop t.Parallel().
#
# An entry here is a claim that a test is right to be both parallel and
# global, which is a claim that needs a reason in the commit that adds it.
#
# Regenerate with: go run ./cmd/tools/audit_parallel_globals -update
# Format: package<TAB>function<TAB>call
